title: My inspections

empty.title: No inspection waits
empty.body: Nothing waits for you or for nobody yet. Scan a lot, a bundle, a serial or a work order to start one.

scanToStart: Scan the lot, the bundle, a garment's serial or the carton at the bench, or press Inspect.

held.noFloorScreen: Incoming inspections are recorded in the office until their floor screen comes.
held.noTile: This station has no screen for it: open it at the inspection bench.
held.notYours: It is another inspector's: they record it.

offline: My inspections were not read on this tablet yet. Scan a code to work anyway: the bench says what it knows.

error.title: My inspections could not be read
error.body: Scan a lot, a bundle or a work order to work anyway, or try again.

gone.title: No longer waiting
gone.body: This inspection left the queue: it was signed, cancelled or taken by another inspector.

scan.label: Scan a lot, a bundle, a serial or a work order
scan.hint: The final bench opens with it: the right inspection, or a new one on its plan.
